# Operations Capstone Transfer Practice: Check route-prefix coverage

This separate optional practice follows the required routed capstone. Diagnose
a route whose network number looks correct but whose prefix is too narrow.
The proxy already points to the intended backend. Preserve the first failure,
correct one route field and explain why an A answer or an IPv6 success cannot
substitute for the missing IPv4 path.

## Prepare the isolated Linux lab

Use an owned Linux VM with root access and network/mount namespace support.
The source workspace edits, saves and exports files; run the exported project
in that Linux VM. Python is supplied apparatus; the task is network diagnosis,
case configuration and an evidence-based explanation.

On an administered Debian/Ubuntu practice VM, prepare the tools once:

    sudo apt-get update
    sudo apt-get install python3 iproute2 iptables util-linux curl dnsutils tcpdump dnsmasq-base

Record distribution, kernel and tool versions. A missing command or refused
namespace is a prerequisite failure, separate from the intended case fault.
Each role contains main.py, capstone_lab.py, case.json, network-notes.md and
edge-cases.md. Keep them together and read this shared README.md. The learner
and reference workspaces keep separate source, notebooks and output folders.

The fixture creates an outer private network and mount context, private /run
and three owned client/router/server namespaces. Its IPv4 endpoints use the
reserved 198.18.0.0/15 range; IPv6 uses 2001:db8::/32. Its fictional names end
in .capstone.test. Host resolver files and persistent services are unchanged.
The fixture removes its own namespaces/workers and compares the calling
host's routes, links and firewall configuration before and after each run.

## Locate the endpoints

| Endpoint | Default value | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Client and next hop | 198.18.31.2/30; 198.18.31.1 | Request source and directly connected router |
| Server link | 198.18.32.0/30 | Router .1; server .2 |
| Client IPv6 and next hop | 2001:db8:31::2/64; ::1 | Separate IPv6 routed path |
| Server IPv6 | 2001:db8:32::2/64 | Resolver/proxy destination |
| Resolver | server UDP 15353 | Owned A/AAAA answers |
| Public proxy | server TCP 8080 | Forwards to a loopback application |
| Intended backend | 127.0.0.1:9000 | Correct application identity |
| Denial control | server TCP 8088 | Owned listening control, denied directly to the client |

The server has a return route through its router. The router forwards both
families. The server permits the declared client to query the resolver and
contact the proxy, allows loopback/established replies and required IPv6
control traffic, and drops other new client traffic. The backend binds only
to loopback. A denied probe needs a viable route and an actual listener before
it supports a policy interpretation.

The resolver answers blue.capstone.test. Queries over IPv6 can return an IPv4
A answer even when the later IPv4 route fails. Keep resolver transport, record
type and application destination separate.

## Predict prefix membership before running

case.json initially sets ipv4_service_route to 198.18.32.0/31 and
proxy_upstream_port to 9000. This /31 route covers .0 and .1. The server's .2
address lies outside it; the server-link /30 covers .0 through .3.
This comparison concerns route-prefix membership. It does not readdress the
server link or assign a /31 point-to-point subnet.

From the extracted learner directory:

    sudo python3 main.py --output ./prefix-first

The unfinished configuration exits 1. Preserve the route table,
routeGetServerRouter4 and routeGet4. The former selects the far router's .1
address, while the latter cannot select server .2. The directly connected
client next hop remains 198.18.31.1. Do not confuse those two router addresses.

The IPv6 resolver can still return A = 198.18.32.2 and AAAA =
2001:db8:32::2. Its IPv6 application request returns the correct owned
body, while the IPv4 application request records status 000 and a nonzero
command result. An IPv4 denied-control failure in this unfinished case is
already explained by routing and does not prove that the server policy ran.

Change only ipv4_service_route to 198.18.32.0/30, covering the supplied complete
server link. Keep proxy_upstream_port at 9000. Run:

    sudo python3 main.py --output ./prefix-corrected

Check completed=true and exit 0 only after both families reach the intended
application. Reconcile the route, source/next hop, A/AAAA answers, owned
fixture/token, /health 200, /missing 404 and three denied direct probes.
The control listeners must exist and the restored IPv4 path must be viable
before interpreting the completed denial evidence.

Compare the original, corrected and alternate route tables and capture.
Explain the difference between prefix membership, route selection and an
actual application response. The reference supplies the same apparatus and
completed one-field case; keep its run separate from the learner evidence.

## Repeat with changed endpoints

    sudo python3 main.py --alternate --output ./alternate-observation

The alternate case changes the client link to 198.18.41.0/30 and
2001:db8:41::/64, the name to amber.capstone.test and the proxy port to 8087.
The server link, intended backend 9000 and control 8088 stay fixed. Predict the
changed source addresses, client next hop, policy rows, name and packet ports
before comparing the new run. Use its own token and exact source case.

Keep receipt.json, inside.json, commands.json, parent-commands.json,
case-used.json, service/DNS/capture logs, response bodies and capture.pcap.
The report records commands after the owned topology has been removed.
Re-run into a fresh folder for another observation; those names are not a
persistent environment to probe after completion. The bounded capture observes
the server interface, proxy TCP and resolver UDP. It supports only that run's
plaintext exchanges, not encrypted payload visibility or general reliability.

## Cleanup, interruption and review

Confirm allWorkersReaped, an empty remainingNamespaces list, distinct private
network/mount identities and receipt.json's actual before/after comparison.
A successful HTTP request does not establish cleanup. Preserve failures and
interrupted attempts separately. The fixture has a 35-second outer run bound,
supervised commands and worker cleanup. Use Ctrl-C to cancel an owned running
attempt; keep its nonzero cancellation and recovery evidence.

For an optional interruption observation, run:

    sudo python3 main.py --hold-after-ready 15 --output ./interruption-observation

In a second terminal check for interruption-observation/ready.json. Once it
exists, press Ctrl-C in the first terminal during the hold. If the hold ended,
retain that ordinary result and use a new output folder for the next attempt.
Compare actual reaping and host restoration with a normal completed run.
Namespace or firewall support may be restricted by the VM/container. Preserve a
prerequisite error and stop that attempt instead of changing host protections.

Complete network-notes.md and the named edge cases with actual predictions,
commands, failed and corrected observations, one rejected alternative, the
first failing boundary and a limitation. Independent work records the diagnosis
before consulting the reference. A guided walkthrough pauses at the first
route result, application body and recovery check, using the same evidence.
A passing configuration does not fill the notebook or complete the explanation.

"""Observe a routed operations case in disposable Linux namespaces."""
import argparse
import contextlib
import datetime
import hashlib
import http.client
import http.server
import ipaddress
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

COMMANDS = []
WORKERS = []


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


class Interrupted(Exception):
    pass


def interrupted(_number, _frame):
    raise Interrupted()


def command(argv, timeout=8, check=True):
    argv = [str(value) for value in argv]
    started = now()
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    out = err = b""
    cleanup = "child exited in the supervised lab process group"
    try:
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=timeout)
    except BaseException:
        child.kill()
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=2)
        cleanup = "owned command killed and reaped; enclosing lab group remains supervised"
        raise
    finally:
        result = {"parentTaskId": "network-operations-capstone", "cwd": str(Path.cwd()),
                  "command": argv, "pid": child.pid, "parentPid": os.getpid(),
                  "processGroup": os.getpgrp(), "startTime": started, "endTime": now(),
                  "exitCode": child.returncode, "timeoutSeconds": timeout,
                  "childProcessGroupCleanup": cleanup, "stdout": out.decode(errors="replace"),
                  "stderr": err.decode(errors="replace")}
        COMMANDS.append(result)
    if check and result["exitCode"] != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(result))
    return result


def write_json(path, value):
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    os.replace(temporary, path)


def require_isolation():
    parent_net = os.environ.get("CAPSTONE_PARENT_NET")
    parent_mount = os.environ.get("CAPSTONE_PARENT_MOUNT")
    current = [os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net"), os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/mnt")]
    if not parent_net or not parent_mount or current[0] in {parent_net, os.readlink("/proc/1/ns/net")} or current[1] in {parent_mount, os.readlink("/proc/1/ns/mnt")}:
        raise RuntimeError("Internal lab entry requires distinct owned network and mount namespaces")
    return {"network": current[0], "mount": current[1], "parentNetwork": parent_net, "parentMount": parent_mount}


def host_snapshot():
    result = {}
    for label, argv in [
        ("links", ["ip", "-j", "link", "show"]),
        ("ipv4Routes", ["ip", "-4", "-j", "route", "show", "table", "all"]),
        ("ipv6Routes", ["ip", "-6", "-j", "route", "show", "table", "all"]),
        ("ipv4Policy", ["iptables-save"]), ("ipv6Policy", ["ip6tables-save"]),
    ]:
        text = command(argv)["stdout"]
        if label.endswith("Policy"):
            text = "\n".join(re.sub(r"\[\d+:\d+\]", "[counter]", line) for line in text.splitlines() if not line.startswith("#"))
        elif label.endswith("Routes"):
            rows = json.loads(text)
            for row in rows:
                for volatile in ["expires", "used", "cache", "error"]:
                    row.pop(volatile, None)
            text = json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True)
        result[label] = text
    return result


def worker(argv, output, name):
    path = output / (name + ".log")
    stream = path.open("wb")
    child = subprocess.Popen([str(value) for value in argv], stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    descriptor = {"parentTaskId": "network-operations-capstone", "cwd": str(Path.cwd()),
                  "command": [str(value) for value in argv], "pid": child.pid,
                  "parentPid": os.getpid(), "processGroup": os.getpgrp(),
                  "startTime": now(), "timeoutSeconds": 35, "log": path.name}
    WORKERS.append((child, stream, descriptor))
    return child, path


def stop_workers():
    for child, stream, descriptor in reversed(WORKERS):
        if child.poll() is None:
            child.send_signal(signal.SIGINT if descriptor["log"] == "capture.log" else signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=3)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            child.kill()
            child.wait(timeout=2)
        stream.close()
        descriptor.update(endTime=now(), exitCode=child.returncode,
                          childProcessGroupCleanup="owned worker reaped in enclosing supervised lab group")
    return [descriptor for _child, _stream, descriptor in WORKERS]


class IPv6Server(http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer):
    address_family = socket.AF_INET6

    def server_bind(self):
        self.socket.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_IPV6, socket.IPV6_V6ONLY, 1)
        super().server_bind()


def serve(public_port, upstream_port, token):
    require_isolation()

    class Application(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        fixture_identity = "owned-operations-capstone"

        def do_GET(self):
            status = 200 if self.path == "/health" else 404
            data = json.dumps({"fixture": self.fixture_identity, "token": token, "path": self.path}).encode()
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)

        def log_message(self, _format, *_arguments):
            return

    class DenialControl(Application):
        fixture_identity = "owned-denial-control"

    class Proxy(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self):
            upstream = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", upstream_port, timeout=1)
            try:
                upstream.request("GET", self.path, headers={"Host": "owned-upstream.capstone.test"})
                response = upstream.getresponse()
                status, data = response.status, response.read()
            except OSError:
                status, data = 502, b'{"error":"owned upstream connection failed"}'
            finally:
                upstream.close()
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
            self.send_header("X-Capstone-Proxy", "owned-loopback-upstream")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)

        def log_message(self, _format, *_arguments):
            return

    servers = [http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 9000), Application),
               http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", public_port), Proxy),
               IPv6Server(("::", public_port), Proxy),
               http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8088), DenialControl),
               IPv6Server(("::", 8088), DenialControl)]
    for server in servers:
        server.daemon_threads = True
        threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    print(json.dumps({"event": "listeners-ready", "pid": os.getpid(), "publicPort": public_port,
                      "upstream": "127.0.0.1:9000", "proxyTarget": upstream_port}), flush=True)
    while True:
        time.sleep(0.2)


def inside(case_file, output, alternate, hold):
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupted)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupted)
    case = json.loads(case_file.read_text())
    identities = require_isolation()
    client_net = 41 if alternate else 31
    c4, r4, s4, g4 = f"198.18.{client_net}.2", f"198.18.{client_net}.1", "198.18.32.2", "198.18.32.1"
    c6, r6, s6, g6 = f"2001:db8:{client_net}::2", f"2001:db8:{client_net}::1", "2001:db8:32::2", "2001:db8:32::1"
    port = 8087 if alternate else 8080
    name = ("amber" if alternate else "blue") + ".capstone.test"
    token = hashlib.sha256((name + str(output)).encode()).hexdigest()[:20]
    namespaces = ["ncap-client", "ncap-router", "ncap-server"]
    report = {"event": "operations-capstone", "alternate": alternate, "identities": identities,
              "case": case, "client4": c4, "client6": c6, "server4": s4, "server6": s6,
              "publicPort": port, "name": name, "token": token, "completed": False, "interrupted": False}
    created = []
    result_code = 1

    def ns(name, *argv, check=True, timeout=8):
        return command(["ip", "netns", "exec", name, *argv], check=check, timeout=timeout)

    def http(label, address, target_port, path="/health"):
        if address is None:
            return {"command": None, "status": "unresolved", "body": ""}
        payload = output / (label + ".body")
        host = "[" + address + "]" if ":" in address else address
        result = ns(namespaces[0], "curl", "--noproxy", "*", "-g", "--silent", "--show-error", "--max-time", "1", "--header", "Host: " + name, "--output", str(payload), "--write-out", "%{http_code}", "http://" + host + ":" + str(target_port) + path, check=False, timeout=3)
        return {"command": result, "status": result["stdout"].strip(),
                "body": payload.read_text() if payload.exists() else ""}

    try:
        command(["mount", "--make-rprivate", "/"])
        command(["mount", "-t", "tmpfs", "-o", "mode=0755", "capstone-run", "/run"])
        Path("/run/netns").mkdir()
        for name_space in namespaces:
            command(["ip", "netns", "add", name_space])
            created.append(name_space)
            command(["ip", "-n", name_space, "link", "set", "lo", "up"])
        for left, right, left_ns, right_ns in [("c-r", "r-c", namespaces[0], namespaces[1]), ("r-s", "s-r", namespaces[1], namespaces[2])]:
            command(["ip", "link", "add", left, "type", "veth", "peer", "name", right])
            command(["ip", "link", "set", left, "netns", left_ns])
            command(["ip", "link", "set", right, "netns", right_ns])
            for interface, owner in [(left, left_ns), (right, right_ns)]:
                command(["ip", "-n", owner, "link", "set", interface, "up"])
        for owner, interface, ipv4, ipv6 in [(namespaces[0], "c-r", c4, c6), (namespaces[1], "r-c", r4, r6), (namespaces[1], "r-s", g4, g6), (namespaces[2], "s-r", s4, s6)]:
            command(["ip", "-n", owner, "address", "add", ipv4 + "/30", "dev", interface])
            command(["ip", "-n", owner, "-6", "address", "add", ipv6 + "/64", "dev", interface, "nodad"])
        ns(namespaces[1], "sysctl", "-q", "-w", "net.ipv4.ip_forward=1", "net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=1")
        command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "route", "add", case["ipv4_service_route"], "via", r4])
        command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[2], "route", "add", f"198.18.{client_net}.0/30", "via", g4])
        command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-6", "route", "add", "2001:db8:32::/64", "via", r6])
        command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[2], "-6", "route", "add", f"2001:db8:{client_net}::/64", "via", g6])
        for tool, client in [("iptables", c4), ("ip6tables", c6)]:
            ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-P", "INPUT", "DROP")
            ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-A", "INPUT", "-i", "lo", "-j", "ACCEPT")
            ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-A", "INPUT", "-m", "conntrack", "--ctstate", "ESTABLISHED,RELATED", "-j", "ACCEPT")
            if tool == "ip6tables":
                ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-A", "INPUT", "-p", "ipv6-icmp", "-j", "ACCEPT")
            for protocol, allowed in [("udp", 15353), ("tcp", port)]:
                ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-A", "INPUT", "-s", client, "-p", protocol, "--dport", str(allowed), "-j", "ACCEPT")
        dns_argv = ["ip", "netns", "exec", namespaces[2], "dnsmasq", "--no-daemon", "--conf-file=/dev/null", "--no-hosts", "--no-resolv", "--no-poll", "--cache-size=0", "--user=root", "--bind-interfaces", "--port=15353", "--listen-address=" + s4, "--listen-address=" + s6, "--address=/" + name + "/" + s4, "--address=/" + name + "/" + s6, "--pid-file=" + str(output / "dnsmasq.pid"), "--log-queries"]
        worker(dns_argv, output, "dns")
        service, service_log = worker(["ip", "netns", "exec", namespaces[2], sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "_serve", str(port), str(case["proxy_upstream_port"]), token], output, "service")
        limit = time.monotonic() + 4
        while b'"event": "listeners-ready"' not in service_log.read_bytes():
            if service.poll() is not None or time.monotonic() >= limit:
                raise RuntimeError("Owned service did not create its listeners")
            time.sleep(0.03)
        limit = time.monotonic() + 4
        while True:
            ready_dns = ns(namespaces[0], "dig", "@" + s6, "-p", "15353", name, "A", "+short", "+time=1", "+tries=1", check=False)
            if ready_dns["stdout"].strip() == s4:
                break
            if time.monotonic() >= limit:
                raise RuntimeError("Owned fictional-name resolver did not answer")
        capture, capture_log = worker(["ip", "netns", "exec", namespaces[2], "tcpdump", "-i", "s-r", "-s", "0", "-n", "-U", "-c", "160", "-w", str(output / "capture.pcap"), "tcp port " + str(port) + " or udp port 15353"], output, "capture")
        limit = time.monotonic() + 3
        while b"listening on" not in capture_log.read_bytes():
            if capture.poll() is not None or time.monotonic() >= limit:
                raise RuntimeError("Owned bounded capture did not start")
            time.sleep(0.03)
        write_json(output / "ready.json", {"event": "topology-ready", "pid": os.getpid(), "namespaces": namespaces,
                   "workers": [{"pid": child.pid, "command": descriptor["command"]} for child, _stream, descriptor in WORKERS],
                   "identities": identities})
        if hold:
            time.sleep(hold)
        report["addresses"] = {owner: {family: command(["ip", "-n", owner, flag, "-j", "address", "show"]) for family, flag in [("ipv4", "-4"), ("ipv6", "-6")]} for owner in namespaces}
        report["forwarding"] = ns(namespaces[1], "sysctl", "net.ipv4.ip_forward", "net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding")
        report["routes4"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-4", "route", "show"])
        report["routes6"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-6", "route", "show"])
        report["routeGet4"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-4", "route", "get", s4], check=False)
        report["routeGetServerRouter4"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-4", "route", "get", g4], check=False)
        report["routeGet6"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-6", "route", "get", s6], check=False)
        report["listeners"] = ns(namespaces[2], "ss", "-H", "-lntup")
        report["policy4"] = ns(namespaces[2], "iptables", "-S")
        report["policy6"] = ns(namespaces[2], "ip6tables", "-S")
        report["dns"] = {}
        for record_type in ["A", "AAAA"]:
            result = ns(namespaces[0], "dig", "@" + s6, "-p", "15353", name, record_type, "+short", "+time=1", "+tries=1", check=False)
            report["dns"][record_type] = result
        report["dns4"] = ns(namespaces[0], "dig", "@" + s4, "-p", "15353", name, "A", "+short", "+time=1", "+tries=1", check=False)
        resolved = {}
        for record_type, version, boundary in [("A", 4, "198.18.0.0/15"), ("AAAA", 6, "2001:db8::/32")]:
            try:
                address = ipaddress.ip_address(report["dns"][record_type]["stdout"].strip())
                resolved[record_type] = str(address) if address.version == version and address in ipaddress.ip_network(boundary) else None
            except ValueError:
                resolved[record_type] = None
        report["resolvedDestinations"] = resolved
        report["http4"] = http("http4", resolved["A"], port)
        report["http6"] = http("http6", resolved["AAAA"], port)
        report["missingPath"] = http("missing", resolved["AAAA"], port, "/missing")
        report["denied4"] = http("denied4", s4, 8088)
        report["denied6"] = http("denied6", s6, 8088)
        report["directUpstream"] = http("direct-upstream", s6, 9000)
        expected = [report["dns"]["A"]["stdout"].strip() == s4,
                    report["dns"]["AAAA"]["stdout"].strip() == str(ipaddress.ip_address(s6)),
                    report["dns4"]["stdout"].strip() == s4,
                    report["http4"]["status"] == report["http6"]["status"] == "200",
                    report["missingPath"]["status"] == "404",
                    all(report[key]["status"] == "000" and report[key]["command"]["exitCode"] != 0 for key in ["denied4", "denied6", "directUpstream"])]
        upstream_listeners = [line.split()[4] for line in report["listeners"]["stdout"].splitlines() if len(line.split()) >= 6 and line.split()[4].endswith(":9000")]
        expected.append(upstream_listeners == ["127.0.0.1:9000"])
        expected.append(case["proxy_upstream_port"] == 9000)
        for family in ["http4", "http6"]:
            try:
                body = json.loads(report[family]["body"])
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                body = {}
            expected.append(body == {"fixture": "owned-operations-capstone", "token": token, "path": "/health"})
        report["completed"] = all(expected)
        result_code = 0 if report["completed"] else 1
    except Interrupted:
        report["interrupted"] = True
        result_code = 130
    finally:
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal.SIG_IGN)
        report["workers"] = stop_workers()
        for namespace in reversed(created):
            command(["ip", "netns", "delete", namespace], check=False)
        report["remainingNamespaces"] = command(["ip", "netns", "list"])["stdout"].strip()
        report["allWorkersReaped"] = all(child.poll() is not None for child, _stream, _descriptor in WORKERS)
        if (output / "capture.pcap").exists():
            report["packetRead"] = command(["tcpdump", "-n", "-r", str(output / "capture.pcap")], check=False)
        write_json(output / "inside.json", report)
        write_json(output / "commands.json", COMMANDS)
    return result_code if report["allWorkersReaped"] and not report["remainingNamespaces"] else 70


def main(case_file):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build, diagnose and remove an owned routed operations case")
    parser.add_argument("--alternate", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--hold-after-ready", type=float, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if sys.platform != "linux" or os.geteuid() != 0:
        parser.error("Use sudo in an owned Linux lab with namespace support")
    tools = ["ip", "unshare", "mount", "sysctl", "iptables", "ip6tables", "iptables-save", "ip6tables-save", "dnsmasq", "dig", "tcpdump", "curl", "ss"]
    missing = [tool for tool in tools if not shutil.which(tool)]
    if missing:
        parser.error("Missing native lab tools: " + ", ".join(missing))
    if not 0 <= args.hold_after_ready <= 30:
        parser.error("The ready hold must be between zero and thirty seconds")
    case = json.loads(case_file.read_text())
    if set(case) != {"ipv4_service_route", "proxy_upstream_port"}:
        parser.error("case.json must contain only the route and owned proxy port")
    route = ipaddress.ip_network(case["ipv4_service_route"], strict=True)
    if route.version != 4 or not route.subnet_of(ipaddress.ip_network("198.18.0.0/15")):
        parser.error("The case route must stay in the reserved owned fixture range")
    if type(case["proxy_upstream_port"]) is not int or not 1024 <= case["proxy_upstream_port"] <= 65535:
        parser.error("The owned proxy port must be an integer in 1024..65535")
    output = (args.output or Path.cwd() / ("capstone-observation-" + str(time.time_ns()))).resolve()
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    write_json(output / "case-used.json", case)
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment["CAPSTONE_PARENT_NET"] = os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net")
    environment["CAPSTONE_PARENT_MOUNT"] = os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/mnt")
    versions = {"python": sys.version, "kernel": list(os.uname())}
    for label, argv in [("ip", ["ip", "-V"]), ("iptables", ["iptables", "--version"]), ("dnsmasq", ["dnsmasq", "--version"]), ("dig", ["dig", "-v"]), ("tcpdump", ["tcpdump", "--version"]), ("curl", ["curl", "--version"])]:
        versions[label] = command(argv)
    before = host_snapshot()
    started = now()
    child = subprocess.Popen(["unshare", "--mount", "--net", sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "_inside", str(case_file.resolve()), str(output), "1" if args.alternate else "0", str(args.hold_after_ready)], env=environment, start_new_session=True)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupted)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupted)
    cancelled = False
    try:
        child.wait(timeout=35)
    except (Interrupted, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        cancelled = True
        with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=5)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            child.wait(timeout=2)
    finally:
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal.SIG_IGN)
        after = host_snapshot()
        receipt = {"event": "operations-capstone-parent", "parentTaskId": "network-operations-capstone",
                   "cwd": str(Path.cwd()), "command": child.args, "pid": child.pid, "parentPid": os.getpid(),
                   "startTime": started, "endTime": now(), "exitCode": child.returncode, "timeoutSeconds": 35,
                   "childProcessGroupCleanup": "owned lab process group exited or was terminated and reaped",
                   "before": before, "after": after, "hostUnchanged": before == after,
                   "versions": versions,
                   "cancelled": cancelled, "sourceCaseSha256": hashlib.sha256(case_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        write_json(output / "receipt.json", receipt)
        write_json(output / "parent-commands.json", COMMANDS)
    print(json.dumps({"output": str(output), "labExit": child.returncode, "hostUnchanged": before == after, "cancelled": cancelled}))
    return 130 if cancelled else (child.returncode if before == after else 70)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "_serve":
        serve(int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4])
    elif len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "_inside":
        raise SystemExit(inside(Path(sys.argv[2]), Path(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] == "1", float(sys.argv[5])))
    else:
        raise SystemExit("Run the role's main.py; internal entries require an owned namespace")

"""Observe a routed operations case in disposable Linux namespaces."""
import argparse
import contextlib
import datetime
import hashlib
import http.client
import http.server
import ipaddress
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

COMMANDS = []
WORKERS = []


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


class Interrupted(Exception):
    pass


def interrupted(_number, _frame):
    raise Interrupted()


def command(argv, timeout=8, check=True):
    argv = [str(value) for value in argv]
    started = now()
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    out = err = b""
    cleanup = "child exited in the supervised lab process group"
    try:
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=timeout)
    except BaseException:
        child.kill()
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=2)
        cleanup = "owned command killed and reaped; enclosing lab group remains supervised"
        raise
    finally:
        result = {"parentTaskId": "network-operations-capstone", "cwd": str(Path.cwd()),
                  "command": argv, "pid": child.pid, "parentPid": os.getpid(),
                  "processGroup": os.getpgrp(), "startTime": started, "endTime": now(),
                  "exitCode": child.returncode, "timeoutSeconds": timeout,
                  "childProcessGroupCleanup": cleanup, "stdout": out.decode(errors="replace"),
                  "stderr": err.decode(errors="replace")}
        COMMANDS.append(result)
    if check and result["exitCode"] != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(result))
    return result


def write_json(path, value):
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    os.replace(temporary, path)


def require_isolation():
    parent_net = os.environ.get("CAPSTONE_PARENT_NET")
    parent_mount = os.environ.get("CAPSTONE_PARENT_MOUNT")
    current = [os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net"), os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/mnt")]
    if not parent_net or not parent_mount or current[0] in {parent_net, os.readlink("/proc/1/ns/net")} or current[1] in {parent_mount, os.readlink("/proc/1/ns/mnt")}:
        raise RuntimeError("Internal lab entry requires distinct owned network and mount namespaces")
    return {"network": current[0], "mount": current[1], "parentNetwork": parent_net, "parentMount": parent_mount}


def host_snapshot():
    result = {}
    for label, argv in [
        ("links", ["ip", "-j", "link", "show"]),
        ("ipv4Routes", ["ip", "-4", "-j", "route", "show", "table", "all"]),
        ("ipv6Routes", ["ip", "-6", "-j", "route", "show", "table", "all"]),
        ("ipv4Policy", ["iptables-save"]), ("ipv6Policy", ["ip6tables-save"]),
    ]:
        text = command(argv)["stdout"]
        if label.endswith("Policy"):
            text = "\n".join(re.sub(r"\[\d+:\d+\]", "[counter]", line) for line in text.splitlines() if not line.startswith("#"))
        elif label.endswith("Routes"):
            rows = json.loads(text)
            for row in rows:
                for volatile in ["expires", "used", "cache", "error"]:
                    row.pop(volatile, None)
            text = json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True)
        result[label] = text
    return result


def worker(argv, output, name):
    path = output / (name + ".log")
    stream = path.open("wb")
    child = subprocess.Popen([str(value) for value in argv], stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    descriptor = {"parentTaskId": "network-operations-capstone", "cwd": str(Path.cwd()),
                  "command": [str(value) for value in argv], "pid": child.pid,
                  "parentPid": os.getpid(), "processGroup": os.getpgrp(),
                  "startTime": now(), "timeoutSeconds": 35, "log": path.name}
    WORKERS.append((child, stream, descriptor))
    return child, path


def stop_workers():
    for child, stream, descriptor in reversed(WORKERS):
        if child.poll() is None:
            child.send_signal(signal.SIGINT if descriptor["log"] == "capture.log" else signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=3)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            child.kill()
            child.wait(timeout=2)
        stream.close()
        descriptor.update(endTime=now(), exitCode=child.returncode,
                          childProcessGroupCleanup="owned worker reaped in enclosing supervised lab group")
    return [descriptor for _child, _stream, descriptor in WORKERS]


class IPv6Server(http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer):
    address_family = socket.AF_INET6

    def server_bind(self):
        self.socket.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_IPV6, socket.IPV6_V6ONLY, 1)
        super().server_bind()


def serve(public_port, upstream_port, token):
    require_isolation()

    class Application(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        fixture_identity = "owned-operations-capstone"

        def do_GET(self):
            status = 200 if self.path == "/health" else 404
            data = json.dumps({"fixture": self.fixture_identity, "token": token, "path": self.path}).encode()
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)

        def log_message(self, _format, *_arguments):
            return

    class DenialControl(Application):
        fixture_identity = "owned-denial-control"

    class Proxy(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self):
            upstream = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", upstream_port, timeout=1)
            try:
                upstream.request("GET", self.path, headers={"Host": "owned-upstream.capstone.test"})
                response = upstream.getresponse()
                status, data = response.status, response.read()
            except OSError:
                status, data = 502, b'{"error":"owned upstream connection failed"}'
            finally:
                upstream.close()
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
            self.send_header("X-Capstone-Proxy", "owned-loopback-upstream")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)

        def log_message(self, _format, *_arguments):
            return

    servers = [http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 9000), Application),
               http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", public_port), Proxy),
               IPv6Server(("::", public_port), Proxy),
               http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8088), DenialControl),
               IPv6Server(("::", 8088), DenialControl)]
    for server in servers:
        server.daemon_threads = True
        threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    print(json.dumps({"event": "listeners-ready", "pid": os.getpid(), "publicPort": public_port,
                      "upstream": "127.0.0.1:9000", "proxyTarget": upstream_port}), flush=True)
    while True:
        time.sleep(0.2)


def inside(case_file, output, alternate, hold):
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupted)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupted)
    case = json.loads(case_file.read_text())
    identities = require_isolation()
    client_net = 41 if alternate else 31
    c4, r4, s4, g4 = f"198.18.{client_net}.2", f"198.18.{client_net}.1", "198.18.32.2", "198.18.32.1"
    c6, r6, s6, g6 = f"2001:db8:{client_net}::2", f"2001:db8:{client_net}::1", "2001:db8:32::2", "2001:db8:32::1"
    port = 8087 if alternate else 8080
    name = ("amber" if alternate else "blue") + ".capstone.test"
    token = hashlib.sha256((name + str(output)).encode()).hexdigest()[:20]
    namespaces = ["ncap-client", "ncap-router", "ncap-server"]
    report = {"event": "operations-capstone", "alternate": alternate, "identities": identities,
              "case": case, "client4": c4, "client6": c6, "server4": s4, "server6": s6,
              "publicPort": port, "name": name, "token": token, "completed": False, "interrupted": False}
    created = []
    result_code = 1

    def ns(name, *argv, check=True, timeout=8):
        return command(["ip", "netns", "exec", name, *argv], check=check, timeout=timeout)

    def http(label, address, target_port, path="/health"):
        if address is None:
            return {"command": None, "status": "unresolved", "body": ""}
        payload = output / (label + ".body")
        host = "[" + address + "]" if ":" in address else address
        result = ns(namespaces[0], "curl", "--noproxy", "*", "-g", "--silent", "--show-error", "--max-time", "1", "--header", "Host: " + name, "--output", str(payload), "--write-out", "%{http_code}", "http://" + host + ":" + str(target_port) + path, check=False, timeout=3)
        return {"command": result, "status": result["stdout"].strip(),
                "body": payload.read_text() if payload.exists() else ""}

    try:
        command(["mount", "--make-rprivate", "/"])
        command(["mount", "-t", "tmpfs", "-o", "mode=0755", "capstone-run", "/run"])
        Path("/run/netns").mkdir()
        for name_space in namespaces:
            command(["ip", "netns", "add", name_space])
            created.append(name_space)
            command(["ip", "-n", name_space, "link", "set", "lo", "up"])
        for left, right, left_ns, right_ns in [("c-r", "r-c", namespaces[0], namespaces[1]), ("r-s", "s-r", namespaces[1], namespaces[2])]:
            command(["ip", "link", "add", left, "type", "veth", "peer", "name", right])
            command(["ip", "link", "set", left, "netns", left_ns])
            command(["ip", "link", "set", right, "netns", right_ns])
            for interface, owner in [(left, left_ns), (right, right_ns)]:
                command(["ip", "-n", owner, "link", "set", interface, "up"])
        for owner, interface, ipv4, ipv6 in [(namespaces[0], "c-r", c4, c6), (namespaces[1], "r-c", r4, r6), (namespaces[1], "r-s", g4, g6), (namespaces[2], "s-r", s4, s6)]:
            command(["ip", "-n", owner, "address", "add", ipv4 + "/30", "dev", interface])
            command(["ip", "-n", owner, "-6", "address", "add", ipv6 + "/64", "dev", interface, "nodad"])
        ns(namespaces[1], "sysctl", "-q", "-w", "net.ipv4.ip_forward=1", "net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=1")
        command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "route", "add", case["ipv4_service_route"], "via", r4])
        command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[2], "route", "add", f"198.18.{client_net}.0/30", "via", g4])
        command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-6", "route", "add", "2001:db8:32::/64", "via", r6])
        command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[2], "-6", "route", "add", f"2001:db8:{client_net}::/64", "via", g6])
        for tool, client in [("iptables", c4), ("ip6tables", c6)]:
            ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-P", "INPUT", "DROP")
            ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-A", "INPUT", "-i", "lo", "-j", "ACCEPT")
            ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-A", "INPUT", "-m", "conntrack", "--ctstate", "ESTABLISHED,RELATED", "-j", "ACCEPT")
            if tool == "ip6tables":
                ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-A", "INPUT", "-p", "ipv6-icmp", "-j", "ACCEPT")
            for protocol, allowed in [("udp", 15353), ("tcp", port)]:
                ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-A", "INPUT", "-s", client, "-p", protocol, "--dport", str(allowed), "-j", "ACCEPT")
        dns_argv = ["ip", "netns", "exec", namespaces[2], "dnsmasq", "--no-daemon", "--conf-file=/dev/null", "--no-hosts", "--no-resolv", "--no-poll", "--cache-size=0", "--user=root", "--bind-interfaces", "--port=15353", "--listen-address=" + s4, "--listen-address=" + s6, "--address=/" + name + "/" + s4, "--address=/" + name + "/" + s6, "--pid-file=" + str(output / "dnsmasq.pid"), "--log-queries"]
        worker(dns_argv, output, "dns")
        service, service_log = worker(["ip", "netns", "exec", namespaces[2], sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "_serve", str(port), str(case["proxy_upstream_port"]), token], output, "service")
        limit = time.monotonic() + 4
        while b'"event": "listeners-ready"' not in service_log.read_bytes():
            if service.poll() is not None or time.monotonic() >= limit:
                raise RuntimeError("Owned service did not create its listeners")
            time.sleep(0.03)
        limit = time.monotonic() + 4
        while True:
            ready_dns = ns(namespaces[0], "dig", "@" + s6, "-p", "15353", name, "A", "+short", "+time=1", "+tries=1", check=False)
            if ready_dns["stdout"].strip() == s4:
                break
            if time.monotonic() >= limit:
                raise RuntimeError("Owned fictional-name resolver did not answer")
        capture, capture_log = worker(["ip", "netns", "exec", namespaces[2], "tcpdump", "-i", "s-r", "-s", "0", "-n", "-U", "-c", "160", "-w", str(output / "capture.pcap"), "tcp port " + str(port) + " or udp port 15353"], output, "capture")
        limit = time.monotonic() + 3
        while b"listening on" not in capture_log.read_bytes():
            if capture.poll() is not None or time.monotonic() >= limit:
                raise RuntimeError("Owned bounded capture did not start")
            time.sleep(0.03)
        write_json(output / "ready.json", {"event": "topology-ready", "pid": os.getpid(), "namespaces": namespaces,
                   "workers": [{"pid": child.pid, "command": descriptor["command"]} for child, _stream, descriptor in WORKERS],
                   "identities": identities})
        if hold:
            time.sleep(hold)
        report["addresses"] = {owner: {family: command(["ip", "-n", owner, flag, "-j", "address", "show"]) for family, flag in [("ipv4", "-4"), ("ipv6", "-6")]} for owner in namespaces}
        report["forwarding"] = ns(namespaces[1], "sysctl", "net.ipv4.ip_forward", "net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding")
        report["routes4"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-4", "route", "show"])
        report["routes6"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-6", "route", "show"])
        report["routeGet4"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-4", "route", "get", s4], check=False)
        report["routeGetServerRouter4"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-4", "route", "get", g4], check=False)
        report["routeGet6"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-6", "route", "get", s6], check=False)
        report["listeners"] = ns(namespaces[2], "ss", "-H", "-lntup")
        report["policy4"] = ns(namespaces[2], "iptables", "-S")
        report["policy6"] = ns(namespaces[2], "ip6tables", "-S")
        report["dns"] = {}
        for record_type in ["A", "AAAA"]:
            result = ns(namespaces[0], "dig", "@" + s6, "-p", "15353", name, record_type, "+short", "+time=1", "+tries=1", check=False)
            report["dns"][record_type] = result
        report["dns4"] = ns(namespaces[0], "dig", "@" + s4, "-p", "15353", name, "A", "+short", "+time=1", "+tries=1", check=False)
        resolved = {}
        for record_type, version, boundary in [("A", 4, "198.18.0.0/15"), ("AAAA", 6, "2001:db8::/32")]:
            try:
                address = ipaddress.ip_address(report["dns"][record_type]["stdout"].strip())
                resolved[record_type] = str(address) if address.version == version and address in ipaddress.ip_network(boundary) else None
            except ValueError:
                resolved[record_type] = None
        report["resolvedDestinations"] = resolved
        report["http4"] = http("http4", resolved["A"], port)
        report["http6"] = http("http6", resolved["AAAA"], port)
        report["missingPath"] = http("missing", resolved["AAAA"], port, "/missing")
        report["denied4"] = http("denied4", s4, 8088)
        report["denied6"] = http("denied6", s6, 8088)
        report["directUpstream"] = http("direct-upstream", s6, 9000)
        expected = [report["dns"]["A"]["stdout"].strip() == s4,
                    report["dns"]["AAAA"]["stdout"].strip() == str(ipaddress.ip_address(s6)),
                    report["dns4"]["stdout"].strip() == s4,
                    report["http4"]["status"] == report["http6"]["status"] == "200",
                    report["missingPath"]["status"] == "404",
                    all(report[key]["status"] == "000" and report[key]["command"]["exitCode"] != 0 for key in ["denied4", "denied6", "directUpstream"])]
        upstream_listeners = [line.split()[4] for line in report["listeners"]["stdout"].splitlines() if len(line.split()) >= 6 and line.split()[4].endswith(":9000")]
        expected.append(upstream_listeners == ["127.0.0.1:9000"])
        expected.append(case["proxy_upstream_port"] == 9000)
        for family in ["http4", "http6"]:
            try:
                body = json.loads(report[family]["body"])
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                body = {}
            expected.append(body == {"fixture": "owned-operations-capstone", "token": token, "path": "/health"})
        report["completed"] = all(expected)
        result_code = 0 if report["completed"] else 1
    except Interrupted:
        report["interrupted"] = True
        result_code = 130
    finally:
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal.SIG_IGN)
        report["workers"] = stop_workers()
        for namespace in reversed(created):
            command(["ip", "netns", "delete", namespace], check=False)
        report["remainingNamespaces"] = command(["ip", "netns", "list"])["stdout"].strip()
        report["allWorkersReaped"] = all(child.poll() is not None for child, _stream, _descriptor in WORKERS)
        if (output / "capture.pcap").exists():
            report["packetRead"] = command(["tcpdump", "-n", "-r", str(output / "capture.pcap")], check=False)
        write_json(output / "inside.json", report)
        write_json(output / "commands.json", COMMANDS)
    return result_code if report["allWorkersReaped"] and not report["remainingNamespaces"] else 70


def main(case_file):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build, diagnose and remove an owned routed operations case")
    parser.add_argument("--alternate", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--hold-after-ready", type=float, default=0)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if sys.platform != "linux" or os.geteuid() != 0:
        parser.error("Use sudo in an owned Linux lab with namespace support")
    tools = ["ip", "unshare", "mount", "sysctl", "iptables", "ip6tables", "iptables-save", "ip6tables-save", "dnsmasq", "dig", "tcpdump", "curl", "ss"]
    missing = [tool for tool in tools if not shutil.which(tool)]
    if missing:
        parser.error("Missing native lab tools: " + ", ".join(missing))
    if not 0 <= args.hold_after_ready <= 30:
        parser.error("The ready hold must be between zero and thirty seconds")
    case = json.loads(case_file.read_text())
    if set(case) != {"ipv4_service_route", "proxy_upstream_port"}:
        parser.error("case.json must contain only the route and owned proxy port")
    route = ipaddress.ip_network(case["ipv4_service_route"], strict=True)
    if route.version != 4 or not route.subnet_of(ipaddress.ip_network("198.18.0.0/15")):
        parser.error("The case route must stay in the reserved owned fixture range")
    if type(case["proxy_upstream_port"]) is not int or not 1024 <= case["proxy_upstream_port"] <= 65535:
        parser.error("The owned proxy port must be an integer in 1024..65535")
    output = (args.output or Path.cwd() / ("capstone-observation-" + str(time.time_ns()))).resolve()
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    write_json(output / "case-used.json", case)
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    environment["CAPSTONE_PARENT_NET"] = os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net")
    environment["CAPSTONE_PARENT_MOUNT"] = os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/mnt")
    versions = {"python": sys.version, "kernel": list(os.uname())}
    for label, argv in [("ip", ["ip", "-V"]), ("iptables", ["iptables", "--version"]), ("dnsmasq", ["dnsmasq", "--version"]), ("dig", ["dig", "-v"]), ("tcpdump", ["tcpdump", "--version"]), ("curl", ["curl", "--version"])]:
        versions[label] = command(argv)
    before = host_snapshot()
    started = now()
    child = subprocess.Popen(["unshare", "--mount", "--net", sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "_inside", str(case_file.resolve()), str(output), "1" if args.alternate else "0", str(args.hold_after_ready)], env=environment, start_new_session=True)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupted)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupted)
    cancelled = False
    try:
        child.wait(timeout=35)
    except (Interrupted, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        cancelled = True
        with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=5)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            with contextlib.suppress(ProcessLookupError):
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            child.wait(timeout=2)
    finally:
        signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal.SIG_IGN)
        after = host_snapshot()
        receipt = {"event": "operations-capstone-parent", "parentTaskId": "network-operations-capstone",
                   "cwd": str(Path.cwd()), "command": child.args, "pid": child.pid, "parentPid": os.getpid(),
                   "startTime": started, "endTime": now(), "exitCode": child.returncode, "timeoutSeconds": 35,
                   "childProcessGroupCleanup": "owned lab process group exited or was terminated and reaped",
                   "before": before, "after": after, "hostUnchanged": before == after,
                   "versions": versions,
                   "cancelled": cancelled, "sourceCaseSha256": hashlib.sha256(case_file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        write_json(output / "receipt.json", receipt)
        write_json(output / "parent-commands.json", COMMANDS)
    print(json.dumps({"output": str(output), "labExit": child.returncode, "hostUnchanged": before == after, "cancelled": cancelled}))
    return 130 if cancelled else (child.returncode if before == after else 70)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "_serve":
        serve(int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4])
    elif len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "_inside":
        raise SystemExit(inside(Path(sys.argv[2]), Path(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4] == "1", float(sys.argv[5])))
    else:
        raise SystemExit("Run the role's main.py; internal entries require an owned namespace")

README.md.content:
# Operations Capstone Extension Practice: Identify a responding backend

This separate optional practice follows the required routed capstone. A proxy
can connect and return HTTP 200 from an owned application that is the wrong
backend for the task. Diagnose that service-identity mismatch while preserving
working routes, resolver answers and least-exposure policy.

## Prepare the isolated Linux lab

Use an owned Linux VM with root access and network/mount namespace support.
The source workspace edits, saves and exports files; run the exported project
in that Linux VM. Python is supplied apparatus; the task is network diagnosis,
case configuration and an evidence-based explanation.

On an administered Debian/Ubuntu practice VM, prepare the tools once:

    sudo apt-get update
    sudo apt-get install python3 iproute2 iptables util-linux curl dnsutils tcpdump dnsmasq-base

Record distribution, kernel and tool versions. A missing command or refused
namespace is a prerequisite failure, separate from the intended case fault.
Each role contains main.py, capstone_lab.py, case.json, network-notes.md and
edge-cases.md. Keep them together and read this shared README.md. The learner
and reference workspaces keep separate source, notebooks and output folders.

The fixture creates an outer private network and mount context, private /run
and three owned client/router/server namespaces. Its IPv4 endpoints use the
reserved 198.18.0.0/15 range; IPv6 uses 2001:db8::/32. Its fictional names end
in .capstone.test. Host resolver files and persistent services are unchanged.
The fixture removes its own namespaces/workers and compares the calling
host's routes, links and firewall configuration before and after each run.

## Locate the endpoints

| Endpoint | Default value | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Client and next hop | 198.18.31.2/30; 198.18.31.1 | Request source and directly connected router |
| Server link | 198.18.32.0/30 | Router .1; server .2 |
| Client IPv6 and next hop | 2001:db8:31::2/64; ::1 | Separate IPv6 routed path |
| Server IPv6 | 2001:db8:32::2/64 | Resolver/proxy destination |
| Resolver | server UDP 15353 | Owned A/AAAA answers |
| Public proxy | server TCP 8080 | Forwards to a loopback application |
| Intended backend | 127.0.0.1:9000 | Correct application identity |
| Denial control | server TCP 8088 | Owned listening control, denied directly to the client |

The server has a return route through its router. The router forwards both
families. The server permits the declared client to query the resolver and
contact the proxy, allows loopback/established replies and required IPv6
control traffic, and drops other new client traffic. The backend binds only
to loopback. A denied probe needs a viable route and an actual listener before
it supports a policy interpretation.

The resolver answers blue.capstone.test. Queries over IPv6 can return an IPv4
A answer even when the later IPv4 route fails. Keep resolver transport, record
type and application destination separate.

## Predict the identity, not only the status

case.json initially contains the correct server route 198.18.32.0/30 and sets
proxy_upstream_port to the owned control listener 8088. The intended backend
is 127.0.0.1:9000. The control is deliberately reachable from server loopback,
even though direct client access to its external socket is denied.

From the extracted learner directory:

    sudo python3 main.py --output ./identity-first

The unfinished case exits 1 with completed=false, while both proxy requests
can return HTTP 200. Read each response body and service.log's proxyTarget.
The wrong response has fixture = owned-denial-control. Its token belongs to the
same owned experiment, so a matching token alone is insufficient. The required
body identifies owned-operations-capstone, the run's token and /health.

Check the recorded route selection, A/AAAA answers, actual listening endpoints
and policy first. Successful routing and TCP narrow the diagnosis; they do not
identify which responding application generated the proxy body. The proxy
header identifies the intermediate proxy, and does not certify its backend.
The recorded target distinguishes 8088 from the intended loopback port 9000.

Change only proxy_upstream_port to 9000. Retain the route and every earlier
output. Run:

    sudo python3 main.py --output ./identity-corrected

Reconcile service.log, the 127.0.0.1:9000 listener, the correct fixture label and
per-run token over both families, /health 200 and /missing 404. Check the two
direct control probes and direct backend probe remain denied. Compare
completed=true and exit 0 with the earlier false case; HTTP 200 alone is not
the completion criterion.

Explain why the proxy can reach the control over loopback while a direct client
probe fails the server policy. The control remains a separate owned service;
broadening its exposure is not a correction. Keep raw bodies, configurations,
commands, packet evidence and the actual cleanup records for both states.
Compare the reference only after an independent endpoint/identity diagnosis.

## Repeat with changed endpoints

    sudo python3 main.py --alternate --output ./alternate-observation

The alternate case changes the client link to 198.18.41.0/30 and
2001:db8:41::/64, the name to amber.capstone.test and the proxy port to 8087.
The server link, intended backend 9000 and control 8088 stay fixed. Predict the
changed source addresses, client next hop, policy rows, name and packet ports
before comparing the new run. Use its own token and exact source case.

Keep receipt.json, inside.json, commands.json, parent-commands.json,
case-used.json, service/DNS/capture logs, response bodies and capture.pcap.
The report records commands after the owned topology has been removed.
Re-run into a fresh folder for another observation; those names are not a
persistent environment to probe after completion. The bounded capture observes
the server interface, proxy TCP and resolver UDP. It supports only that run's
plaintext exchanges, not encrypted payload visibility or general reliability.

## Cleanup, interruption and review

Confirm allWorkersReaped, an empty remainingNamespaces list, distinct private
network/mount identities and receipt.json's actual before/after comparison.
A successful HTTP request does not establish cleanup. Preserve failures and
interrupted attempts separately. The fixture has a 35-second outer run bound,
supervised commands and worker cleanup. Use Ctrl-C to cancel an owned running
attempt; keep its nonzero cancellation and recovery evidence.

For an optional interruption observation, run:

    sudo python3 main.py --hold-after-ready 15 --output ./interruption-observation

In a second terminal check for interruption-observation/ready.json. Once it
exists, press Ctrl-C in the first terminal during the hold. If the hold ended,
retain that ordinary result and use a new output folder for the next attempt.
Compare actual reaping and host restoration with a normal completed run.
Namespace or firewall support may be restricted by the VM/container. Preserve a
prerequisite error and stop that attempt instead of changing host protections.

Complete network-notes.md and the named edge cases with actual predictions,
commands, failed and corrected observations, one rejected alternative, the
first failing boundary and a limitation. Independent work records the diagnosis
before consulting the reference. A guided walkthrough pauses at the first
route result, application body and recovery check, using the same evidence.
A passing configuration does not fill the notebook or complete the explanation.

"""Observe a routed operations case in disposable Linux namespaces."""
import argparse
import contextlib
import datetime
import hashlib
import http.client
import http.server
import ipaddress
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

COMMANDS = []
WORKERS = []


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


class Interrupted(Exception):
    pass


def interrupted(_number, _frame):
    raise Interrupted()


def command(argv, timeout=8, check=True):
    argv = [str(value) for value in argv]
    started = now()
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    out = err = b""
    cleanup = "child exited in the supervised lab process group"
    try:
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=timeout)
    except BaseException:
        child.kill()
        out, err = child.communicate(timeout=2)
        cleanup = "owned command killed and reaped; enclosing lab group remains supervised"
        raise
    finally:
        result = {"parentTaskId": "network-operations-capstone", "cwd": str(Path.cwd()),
                  "command": argv, "pid": child.pid, "parentPid": os.getpid(),
                  "processGroup": os.getpgrp(), "startTime": started, "endTime": now(),
                  "exitCode": child.returncode, "timeoutSeconds": timeout,
                  "childProcessGroupCleanup": cleanup, "stdout": out.decode(errors="replace"),
                  "stderr": err.decode(errors="replace")}
        COMMANDS.append(result)
    if check and result["exitCode"] != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(result))
    return result


def write_json(path, value):
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n")
    os.replace(temporary, path)


def require_isolation():
    parent_net = os.environ.get("CAPSTONE_PARENT_NET")
    parent_mount = os.environ.get("CAPSTONE_PARENT_MOUNT")
    current = [os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net"), os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/mnt")]
    if not parent_net or not parent_mount or current[0] in {parent_net, os.readlink("/proc/1/ns/net")} or current[1] in {parent_mount, os.readlink("/proc/1/ns/mnt")}:
        raise RuntimeError("Internal lab entry requires distinct owned network and mount namespaces")
    return {"network": current[0], "mount": current[1], "parentNetwork": parent_net, "parentMount": parent_mount}


def host_snapshot():
    result = {}
    for label, argv in [
        ("links", ["ip", "-j", "link", "show"]),
        ("ipv4Routes", ["ip", "-4", "-j", "route", "show", "table", "all"]),
        ("ipv6Routes", ["ip", "-6", "-j", "route", "show", "table", "all"]),
        ("ipv4Policy", ["iptables-save"]), ("ipv6Policy", ["ip6tables-save"]),
    ]:
        text = command(argv)["stdout"]
        if label.endswith("Policy"):
            text = "\n".join(re.sub(r"\[\d+:\d+\]", "[counter]", line) for line in text.splitlines() if not line.startswith("#"))
        elif label.endswith("Routes"):
            rows = json.loads(text)
            for row in rows:
                for volatile in ["expires", "used", "cache", "error"]:
                    row.pop(volatile, None)
            text = json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True)
        result[label] = text
    return result


def worker(argv, output, name):
    path = output / (name + ".log")
    stream = path.open("wb")
    child = subprocess.Popen([str(value) for value in argv], stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    descriptor = {"parentTaskId": "network-operations-capstone", "cwd": str(Path.cwd()),
                  "command": [str(value) for value in argv], "pid": child.pid,
                  "parentPid": os.getpid(), "processGroup": os.getpgrp(),
                  "startTime": now(), "timeoutSeconds": 35, "log": path.name}
    WORKERS.append((child, stream, descriptor))
    return child, path


def stop_workers():
    for child, stream, descriptor in reversed(WORKERS):
        if child.poll() is None:
            child.send_signal(signal.SIGINT if descriptor["log"] == "capture.log" else signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=3)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            child.kill()
            child.wait(timeout=2)
        stream.close()
        descriptor.update(endTime=now(), exitCode=child.returncode,
                          childProcessGroupCleanup="owned worker reaped in enclosing supervised lab group")
    return [descriptor for _child, _stream, descriptor in WORKERS]


class IPv6Server(http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer):
    address_family = socket.AF_INET6

    def server_bind(self):
        self.socket.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_IPV6, socket.IPV6_V6ONLY, 1)
        super().server_bind()


def serve(public_port, upstream_port, token):
    require_isolation()

    class Application(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        fixture_identity = "owned-operations-capstone"

        def do_GET(self):
            status = 200 if self.path == "/health" else 404
            data = json.dumps({"fixture": self.fixture_identity, "token": token, "path": self.path}).encode()
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)

        def log_message(self, _format, *_arguments):
            return

    class DenialControl(Application):
        fixture_identity = "owned-denial-control"

    class Proxy(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def do_GET(self):
            upstream = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", upstream_port, timeout=1)
            try:
                upstream.request("GET", self.path, headers={"Host": "owned-upstream.capstone.test"})
                response = upstream.getresponse()
                status, data = response.status, response.read()
            except OSError:
                status, data = 502, b'{"error":"owned upstream connection failed"}'
            finally:
                upstream.close()
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
            self.send_header("X-Capstone-Proxy", "owned-loopback-upstream")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)

        def log_message(self, _format, *_arguments):
            return

    servers = [http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 9000), Application),
               http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", public_port), Proxy),
               IPv6Server(("::", public_port), Proxy),
               http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8088), DenialControl),
               IPv6Server(("::", 8088), DenialControl)]
    for server in servers:
        server.daemon_threads = True
        threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    print(json.dumps({"event": "listeners-ready", "pid": os.getpid(), "publicPort": public_port,
                      "upstream": "127.0.0.1:9000", "proxyTarget": upstream_port}), flush=True)
    while True:
        time.sleep(0.2)


def inside(case_file, output, alternate, hold):
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, interrupted)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, interrupted)
    case = json.loads(case_file.read_text())
    identities = require_isolation()
    client_net = 41 if alternate else 31
    c4, r4, s4, g4 = f"198.18.{client_net}.2", f"198.18.{client_net}.1", "198.18.32.2", "198.18.32.1"
    c6, r6, s6, g6 = f"2001:db8:{client_net}::2", f"2001:db8:{client_net}::1", "2001:db8:32::2", "2001:db8:32::1"
    port = 8087 if alternate else 8080
    name = ("amber" if alternate else "blue") + ".capstone.test"
    token = hashlib.sha256((name + str(output)).encode()).hexdigest()[:20]
    namespaces = ["ncap-client", "ncap-router", "ncap-server"]
    report = {"event": "operations-capstone", "alternate": alternate, "identities": identities,
              "case": case, "client4": c4, "client6": c6, "server4": s4, "server6": s6,
              "publicPort": port, "name": name, "token": token, "completed": False, "interrupted": False}
    created = []
    result_code = 1

    def ns(name, *argv, check=True, timeout=8):
        return command(["ip", "netns", "exec", name, *argv], check=check, timeout=timeout)

    def http(label, address, target_port, path="/health"):
        if address is None:
            return {"command": None, "status": "unresolved", "body": ""}
        payload = output / (label + ".body")
        host = "[" + address + "]" if ":" in address else address
        result = ns(namespaces[0], "curl", "--noproxy", "*", "-g", "--silent", "--show-error", "--max-time", "1", "--header", "Host: " + name, "--output", str(payload), "--write-out", "%{http_code}", "http://" + host + ":" + str(target_port) + path, check=False, timeout=3)
        return {"command": result, "status": result["stdout"].strip(),
                "body": payload.read_text() if payload.exists() else ""}

    try:
        command(["mount", "--make-rprivate", "/"])
        command(["mount", "-t", "tmpfs", "-o", "mode=0755", "capstone-run", "/run"])
        Path("/run/netns").mkdir()
        for name_space in namespaces:
            command(["ip", "netns", "add", name_space])
            created.append(name_space)
            command(["ip", "-n", name_space, "link", "set", "lo", "up"])
        for left, right, left_ns, right_ns in [("c-r", "r-c", namespaces[0], namespaces[1]), ("r-s", "s-r", namespaces[1], namespaces[2])]:
            command(["ip", "link", "add", left, "type", "veth", "peer", "name", right])
            command(["ip", "link", "set", left, "netns", left_ns])
            command(["ip", "link", "set", right, "netns", right_ns])
            for interface, owner in [(left, left_ns), (right, right_ns)]:
                command(["ip", "-n", owner, "link", "set", interface, "up"])
        for owner, interface, ipv4, ipv6 in [(namespaces[0], "c-r", c4, c6), (namespaces[1], "r-c", r4, r6), (namespaces[1], "r-s", g4, g6), (namespaces[2], "s-r", s4, s6)]:
            command(["ip", "-n", owner, "address", "add", ipv4 + "/30", "dev", interface])
            command(["ip", "-n", owner, "-6", "address", "add", ipv6 + "/64", "dev", interface, "nodad"])
        ns(namespaces[1], "sysctl", "-q", "-w", "net.ipv4.ip_forward=1", "net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=1")
        command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "route", "add", case["ipv4_service_route"], "via", r4])
        command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[2], "route", "add", f"198.18.{client_net}.0/30", "via", g4])
        command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-6", "route", "add", "2001:db8:32::/64", "via", r6])
        command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[2], "-6", "route", "add", f"2001:db8:{client_net}::/64", "via", g6])
        for tool, client in [("iptables", c4), ("ip6tables", c6)]:
            ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-P", "INPUT", "DROP")
            ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-A", "INPUT", "-i", "lo", "-j", "ACCEPT")
            ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-A", "INPUT", "-m", "conntrack", "--ctstate", "ESTABLISHED,RELATED", "-j", "ACCEPT")
            if tool == "ip6tables":
                ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-A", "INPUT", "-p", "ipv6-icmp", "-j", "ACCEPT")
            for protocol, allowed in [("udp", 15353), ("tcp", port)]:
                ns(namespaces[2], tool, "-A", "INPUT", "-s", client, "-p", protocol, "--dport", str(allowed), "-j", "ACCEPT")
        dns_argv = ["ip", "netns", "exec", namespaces[2], "dnsmasq", "--no-daemon", "--conf-file=/dev/null", "--no-hosts", "--no-resolv", "--no-poll", "--cache-size=0", "--user=root", "--bind-interfaces", "--port=15353", "--listen-address=" + s4, "--listen-address=" + s6, "--address=/" + name + "/" + s4, "--address=/" + name + "/" + s6, "--pid-file=" + str(output / "dnsmasq.pid"), "--log-queries"]
        worker(dns_argv, output, "dns")
        service, service_log = worker(["ip", "netns", "exec", namespaces[2], sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "_serve", str(port), str(case["proxy_upstream_port"]), token], output, "service")
        limit = time.monotonic() + 4
        while b'"event": "listeners-ready"' not in service_log.read_bytes():
            if service.poll() is not None or time.monotonic() >= limit:
                raise RuntimeError("Owned service did not create its listeners")
            time.sleep(0.03)
        limit = time.monotonic() + 4
        while True:
            ready_dns = ns(namespaces[0], "dig", "@" + s6, "-p", "15353", name, "A", "+short", "+time=1", "+tries=1", check=False)
            if ready_dns["stdout"].strip() == s4:
                break
            if time.monotonic() >= limit:
                raise RuntimeError("Owned fictional-name resolver did not answer")
        capture, capture_log = worker(["ip", "netns", "exec", namespaces[2], "tcpdump", "-i", "s-r", "-s", "0", "-n", "-U", "-c", "160", "-w", str(output / "capture.pcap"), "tcp port " + str(port) + " or udp port 15353"], output, "capture")
        limit = time.monotonic() + 3
        while b"listening on" not in capture_log.read_bytes():
            if capture.poll() is not None or time.monotonic() >= limit:
                raise RuntimeError("Owned bounded capture did not start")
            time.sleep(0.03)
        write_json(output / "ready.json", {"event": "topology-ready", "pid": os.getpid(), "namespaces": namespaces,
                   "workers": [{"pid": child.pid, "command": descriptor["command"]} for child, _stream, descriptor in WORKERS],
                   "identities": identities})
        if hold:
            time.sleep(hold)
        report["addresses"] = {owner: {family: command(["ip", "-n", owner, flag, "-j", "address", "show"]) for family, flag in [("ipv4", "-4"), ("ipv6", "-6")]} for owner in namespaces}
        report["forwarding"] = ns(namespaces[1], "sysctl", "net.ipv4.ip_forward", "net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding")
        report["routes4"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-4", "route", "show"])
        report["routes6"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-6", "route", "show"])
        report["routeGet4"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-4", "route", "get", s4], check=False)
        report["routeGetServerRouter4"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-4", "route", "get", g4], check=False)
        report["routeGet6"] = command(["ip", "-n", namespaces[0], "-6", "route", "get", s6], check=False)
        report["listeners"] = ns(namespaces[2], "ss", "-H", "-lntup")
        report["policy4"] = ns(namespaces[2], "iptables", "-S")
        report["policy6"] = ns(namespaces[2], "ip6tables", "-S")
        report["dns"] = {}
        for record_type in ["A", "AAAA"]:
            result = ns(namespaces[0], "dig", "@" + s6, "-p", "15353", name, record_type, "+short", "+time=1", "+tries=1", check=False)
            report["dns"][record_type] = result
        report["dns4"] = ns(namespaces[0], "dig", "@" + s4, "-p", "15353", name, "A", "+short", "+time=1", "+tries=1", check=False)
        resolved = {}
        for record_type, version, boundary in [("A", 4, "198.18.0.0/15"), ("AAAA", 6, "2001:db8::/32")]:
            try:
                address = ipaddress.ip_address(report["dns"][record_type]["stdout"].strip())
                resolved[record_type] = str(address) if address.version == version and address in ipaddress.ip_network(boundary) else None
            except ValueError:
                resolved[record_type] = None
        report["resolvedDestinations"] = resolved
        report["http4"] = http("http4", resolved["A"], port)
        report["http6"] = http("http6", resolved["AAAA"], port)
        report["missingPath"] = http("missing", resolved["AAAA"], port, "/missing")
        report["denied4"] = http("denied4", s4, 8088)
        report["denied6"] = http("denied6", s6, 8088)
        report["directUpstream"] = http("direct-upstream", s6, 9000)
        expected = [report["dns"]["A"]["stdout"].strip() == s4,
                    report["dns"]["AAAA"]["stdout"].strip() == str(ipaddress.ip_address(s6)),
                    report["dns4"]["stdout"].strip() == s4,
                    report["http4"]["status"] == report["http6"]["status"] == "200",
                    report["missingPath"]["status"] == "404",
